title: Merge the functionality of Active Window Control into Task Manager when borderlessMaximizedWindows mode is active
line: With borderless maximized windows on, the active maximized window's Task Manager entry now has Minimize, Restore and Close buttons next to its title.
explanation: With KWin's "Borderless maximized windows" option, a maximized window has no titlebar, so its minimize, restore and close buttons are gone unless a third-party Active Window Control widget is added, which repeats the window title already shown in the Task Manager. The Task Manager entry already shows the active window's title, so it is the natural place for those buttons. The Task Manager backend now watches kwinrc's BorderlessMaximizedWindows, and the (non icons-only) Task Manager shows small Minimize, Restore and Close buttons at the end of the active, maximized window's entry while that option is on.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show window buttons for borderless maximized windows

When KWin hides the titlebar of maximized windows, the active window had
no visible minimize, restore or close buttons unless an extra widget was
added. Its Task Manager entry now shows these buttons in that case.

BUG: 444734
